messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"text":"For just as the ground is given to the wood, and the sea to its waves, even so those who dwell upon the earth may understand nothing but what is upon the earth. Only he who dwells above the heavens understands the things that are above the height of the heavens.”","chapter":4,"verse":21},{"text":"Then answered I and said, “I beg you, O Lord, why has the power of understanding been given to me?","chapter":4,"verse":22},{"text":"For it was not in my mind to be curious of the ways above, but of such things as pass by us daily, because Israel is given up as a reproach to the heathen. The people whom you have loved have been given over to ungodly nations. The law of our forefathers is made of no effect, and the written covenants are nowhere regarded.","chapter":4,"verse":23},{"text":"We pass away out of the world like locusts. Our life is like a vapor, and we aren’t worthy to obtain mercy.","chapter":4,"verse":24},{"text":"What will he then do for his name by which we are called? I have asked about these things.”","chapter":4,"verse":25},{"text":"Then he answered me, and said, “If you are alive you will see, and if you live long, you will marvel, for the world hastens quickly to pass away.","chapter":4,"verse":26},{"text":"For it is not able to bear the things that are promised to the righteous in the times to come; for this world is full of sadness and infirmities.","chapter":4,"verse":27},{"text":"For the evil about which you asked me has been sown, but its harvest hasn’t yet come.","chapter":4,"verse":28},{"text":"If therefore that which is sown isn’t reaped, and if the place where the evil is sown doesn’t pass away, the field where the good is sown won’t come.","chapter":4,"verse":29},{"text":"For a grain of evil seed was sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much wickedness it has produced to this time! How much more it will yet produce until the time of threshing comes!","chapter":4,"verse":30},{"text":"Ponder now by yourself, how much fruit of wickedness a grain of evil seed has produced.","chapter":4,"verse":31},{"text":"When the grains which are without number are sown, how great a threshing floor they will fill!”","chapter":4,"verse":32},{"text":"Then I answered and said, “How long? When will these things come to pass? Why are our years few and evil?”","chapter":4,"verse":33},{"text":"He answered me, and said, “Don’t hurry faster than the Most High; for your haste is for your own self, but he who is above hurries on behalf of many.","chapter":4,"verse":34},{"text":"Didn’t the souls of the righteous ask about these things in their chambers, saying, ‘How long will we be here? When does the fruit of the threshing floor come?’","chapter":4,"verse":35},{"text":"To them, Jeremiel the archangel answered, ‘When the number is fulfilled of those who are like you. For he has weighed the world in the balance.","chapter":4,"verse":36},{"text":"By measure, he has measured the times. By number, he has counted the seasons. He won’t move or stir them until that measure is fulfilled.’”","chapter":4,"verse":37},{"text":"Then I answered, “O sovereign Lord, all of us are full of ungodliness.","chapter":4,"verse":38},{"text":"Perhaps it is for our sakes that the threshing time of the righteous is kept back—because of the sins of those who dwell on the earth.”","chapter":4,"verse":39},{"text":"So he answered me, “Go your way to a woman with child, and ask of her when she has fulfilled her nine months, if her womb may keep the baby any longer within her.”","chapter":4,"verse":40}],"chapter":4,"book_code":"2ES"}
